claim_boundary: This matrix maps M2-foundation needs to current implementation evidence and planned owners. It does not claim implementation completion, frontend delivery, broad semantic accuracy, or M2 acceptance.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Open the application with one bounded picture of compatibility, health, configuration, capabilities, and resumable work.
capabilities.gap: No user-oriented bootstrap projection joins compatibility, capability, configuration, and resumable operation state.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Generated native and TypeScript consumers recover the same bounded bootstrap and typed resync states.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Detect MO2 and applicable LOOT state, explain capability gaps, and let the user confirm or correct exact tool locations safely.
capabilities.gap: No coherent application query/typed native override workflow or saved user settings path.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Exact tool states and typed overrides persist, revalidate, and expose capability consequences without generic path authority.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Show valid MO2 profiles and bind each run to one profile the user explicitly selected or confirmed.
current_evidence: M1 explicit profile binding in snapshot/configuration input
MO2 saved selection is suggestion-only by ADR-0008
capabilities.gap: No application list/suggestion/confirm/revision workflow for ordinary users.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Suggested and confirmed selection remain distinct and an unconfirmed suggestion cannot start a run.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Create, name, clone, inspect, edit, and delete reusable scan configurations while every run keeps its exact effective values.
capabilities.gap: No versioned user-facing saved-configuration CRUD/clone application vertical.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Saved configurations round-trip with revision conflicts and active runs retain immutable effective configuration.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Explain planned work, limits, capability gaps, time, usage, and cost authority before long or paid work begins.
current_evidence: Retained effective configuration and local limit substrate
capabilities.gap: No complete user-facing pre-run projection and typed confirmation; unavailable estimate authority is not assembled for a frontend.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Pre-run review exposes exact limits, planned work, estimates, and unavailable dimensions without invented billing or completion promises.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Show non-secret provider readiness and allow safe add/replace/cancel credential enrollment.
capabilities.gap: No desktop application choreography or renderer-safe status/enrollment consumer; product and development credential paths must remain distinct.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: React receives only non-secret status/outcomes and the helper owns entry and exact-target secure storage.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Start a validated analysis from confirmed user selections without exposing internal orchestration instructions.
capabilities.gap: Current start substrate includes raw internal orchestration JSON and is not a renderer-safe user operation.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Typed user input resolves internally to the durable M1 path and raw orchestration/provider operations are unreachable from the renderer.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Show authoritative progress, time, cost, failures, and gaps and recover after renderer, shell, or coordinator interruption.
capabilities.gap: Needs user-oriented rollups, renderer/session mapping, and end-to-end desktop reload/reconnect proof.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Native and desktop diagnostic consumers recover from loss without owning durable state or duplicating cost.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Open a result with readiness or an explicit scope-limited status, a concise summary, counts, coverage, cost, duration, failures, and gaps.
capabilities.gap: No complete user-oriented summary projection with all M2 distinctions and claim boundaries.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: All result states produce truthful bounded summaries and no absence-of-findings safety claim.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Browse supported cases and lead-only investigations separately with bounded filters, sorting, search, and pagination.
capabilities.gap: No complete case/investigation queue, user-priority projection, search, or separate detail contract.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Supported and lead-only items remain distinct through paginated queue and detail consumers.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Understand what happened, why it matters, affected subjects, uncertainty, recommendation, validation, and exact report provenance.
capabilities.gap: FindingReport is derived from a local retained artifact and is not a complete coordinator-owned report/detail query surface.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Reports and case/finding details are queryable, bounded, deterministic, inert, and traceable to canonical retained sources.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Expand supporting, contradicting, missing, coverage, and source provenance only when needed.
capabilities.gap: Current diagnostic/artifact queries are not a complete user-oriented bounded evidence expansion model.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Typed inert evidence/provenance chunks expose gaps and never return raw payload paths or privileged content.

capabilities.plain_language_need: See one mod's findings, cases, evidence, documentation, and coverage without turning Infinium into an MO2 conflict browser.
current_evidence: Retained subject/mod identities in M1 outputs
capabilities.gap: No focused-mod aggregation query or bounded detail projection exists.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: One exact mod view aggregates only supported relationships and preserves unrelated causes and coverage gaps.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Record what the user decided about a finding without changing the finding or leaking the decision to a different condition.
capabilities.gap: No complete application command/persistence/readback vertical for user review events and validated carryover.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Revision-bound append-only events survive restart and cannot mutate or suppress an unrelated/new analytical revision.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Create, confirm, edit, remove, inspect, and revalidate profile-specific assumptions without rewriting historical contexts.
capabilities.gap: No durable assumption event/confirmation/revalidation application contract or persistence path.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Origin and confirmation remain distinct and every edit creates successor effective context state with history intact.

capabilities.plain_language_need: After the user changes the external setup, rerun only affected checks and link the new outcome to the earlier issue.
current_evidence: M1 manual run and dependency/replay substrate
capabilities.gap: No user-facing targeted-scope plan/start/lineage contract; targeted results must not borrow unrelated readiness coverage.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: A new manually initiated operation retains exact source scope and lineage and reports scope-limited readiness honestly.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Create a separate local-private structured JSON export from an exact result selection without changing source records.
current_evidence: ADR-0021 sharing classes and typed write authority
capabilities.gap: Run-owned output is not a user-created export and no application export selection/manifest/status path exists.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Export records exact source revisions, filters, sharing class, omissions, privacy/source-policy choices, and does not mutate source truth.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Give frontend code strongly typed operations and deterministic development states that cannot drift silently from the backend.
capabilities.gap: No TypeScript renderer contract/client, operation registry, story states, or generation-drift check exists.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Generated native and TypeScript consumers cover every renderer operation and strict story states without hidden handwritten authority.

capabilities.plain_language_need: Run packaged React in a minimal Windows host and safely map user gestures to the application client.
capabilities.gap: No WPF host, packaged React diagnostic surface, closed bridge, renderer recovery, accessibility evidence, or resource measurements exist.
capabilities.transition_exit_evidence: Executable diagnostic consumer passes controlled-origin, hostile-operation, reconnect, large-list, accessibility-mechanics, and measurement obligations.
